title: Contractor [Warlock]
intro: A restricted architecture provides the class software. Unique artifacts remain separate item rules. This reference covers the original 2014 Player's Handbook class, its three subclasses and all 32 original invocations. Later supplements are outside this core conversion.

sections.title: Class foundation
sections.text:
| Statistic | Contractor |
| --- | --- |
| Hit Die | d8 per Contractor level |
| Starting HP | 8 + Constitution modifier |
| HP at later levels | 5 + Constitution modifier, minimum 1 per level |
| Armour | Light armour |
| Weapons | Simple weapons and simple firearms |
| Tools | None from the class; background can supply them |
| Saving throws | Cool and Intelligence under our six-attribute conversion |
| Class skills | Choose two: Technology, Deception, History, Intimidation, Investigation, Nature, Science |
| Program ability | **Cool** |
| Program attack | Proficiency bonus + Cool modifier |
| Program save DC | 8 + proficiency bonus + Cool modifier |

Technology checks for intrusion still use Intelligence. Ordinary intrusion is resolved through meaningful ability checks; quickhacks use their printed attack or save without a preliminary breach check.

An ordinary Contractor receives the specialist kit: light armour, a simple sidearm, a modular class focus, clothes, agent, backpack, seven days' food and a water container; two loaded magazines accompany a firearm. Background equipment is additional. A campaign's explicit opening can override starting possessions.

sections.title: Level 1 — Architecture Provider
sections.text:
Choose Combat, Deception or Intrusion Architecture. You gain that architecture's features at levels 1, 6, 10 and 14. Its expanded program list adds options you may learn; it does **not** grant those programs automatically.

The provider explains the origin of the technology. It can be a corporation, research project or construct. It does not determine your personality, and disagreement with a provider does not erase earned class levels.

sections.title: Level 1 — Burst Processing
sections.text:
Choose two utilities and two tier-1 programs from the class list. Utilities cost no slots. You know your selected programs continuously rather than preparing a different list each morning.

All your Execution Slots have the same tier. One execution spends one slot and runs at that slot's tier. At level 5, for example, a tier-1 program uses one of your two tier-3 slots and gains its stated tier-3 improvements. A program without higher-tier improvements gains none merely from the larger slot.

Recover all Execution Slots on a short or Long Rest. This does not heal injuries or replace ammunition and supplies. Learning another program does not add another slot.

When you gain a Contractor level, learn any additional programs shown by the table. Each must be tier 1–5 and no higher than your current slot tier. You may also replace one known tiered program with another eligible choice. The base 2014 class supplies no routine utility swap or daily retraining.

A class controller supplies an interface, not the machinery required by every learned program. Programs need compatible reachable electronics and their specific physical requirements. Missing equipment never reappears during rest. Normally you maintain one concentration program: Constitution save when damaged, DC 10 or half the damage, whichever is higher.

The normal 2014 bonus-action casting restriction applies unless a specific artifact feature overrides it. Merely possessing two slots does not let you execute two action programs on one turn.

sections.title: Level 2 — Firmware Upgrades
sections.text:
Choose two upgrades, increasing to eight by level 18 as shown above. Every prerequisite referring to a level means **Contractor level**, not total character level.

Whenever you gain a Contractor level, you may replace one upgrade with another you qualify for. You may qualify for and select an upgrade on the same level. Each upgrade can be selected only once. These are class features, not separately purchased cyberware or additional Load.

sections.title: Level 3 — Interface Platform
sections.text:
Choose one platform. This does not choose or change your architecture.

**Weapon Interface — Blade port.** As an action, deploy a modular melee weapon from its carried housing into an empty hand. Choose its ordinary melee profile when deploying. You are proficient with it; it counts as calibrated against relevant resistance. It uses Body, or Reflexes where finesse permits. It grants neither Cool-based weapon attacks nor a free enhancement bonus.

Only one platform weapon operates at a time. Dismissing it requires no action. It folds when dismissed, replaced or left more than 5 feet from you for a minute; the physical housing stays where it was. A one-hour workshop procedure can integrate an existing melee weapon, including its actual upgrades, unless it is an artifact or sentient weapon. It cannot duplicate equipment, teleport a lost weapon back or produce a firearm. Combat Sequencer and Disruption Edge improve this platform later.

**Drone Link — Chain port.** Gain Scout Drone Deployment [Find Familiar], outside your known-program allowance, and permission to execute it in slow mode. You control one familiar-style scout. You can choose an ordinary scout profile or the advanced Infiltration, Harassment, Sensor or Recon chassis.

The drone rolls its own initiative, follows commands and can move and take nonattack actions. It normally cannot attack. When you take the Attack action, you may forgo one of your attacks to let it make one attack with **its reaction**. This does not give it an additional attack on its own turn.

Within 100 feet and a live connection, you can communicate with it. Full sensory takeover costs an Action: use its sight, hearing and applicable special senses until the start of your next turn; your own sight and hearing are unavailable during that interval.

The Sensor Scout separately sends live optical images through ordinary communication without an Action, Bonus Action or Concentration; you retain your own senses. Use a live feed to execute eligible ranged Programs under Execution's relay rules: your normal execution cost, Program range measured from drone to target, visibility and cover from the drone. Ranged relaying costs no drone Reaction or sacrificed attack. Image reception does not grant its blindsight or Perception bonuses.

A Touch-range Program can be delivered through the drone within 100 feet, using its Reaction and your Program attack modifier if an attack is required. The Program's actual delivery module must be present.

Dismissal folds the drone physically; it does not put it in another dimension. Destroyed units need parts and a one-hour rebuild. The advanced profiles and payload rules are printed in Chassis; Chassis supplies the standard scouts and the current Harassment Scout profile.

**Program Archive — Tome port.** Choose three utilities from any class lists. They become Contractor utilities using Cool and do not count against your ordinary utility allowance. Carry the operational archive to use them. Their target and physical-input requirements still apply.

This does not grant levelled programs or slow-mode execution by itself. Slow-Mode Library supplies the ritual expansion. A lost archive can be replaced in one hour with a blank module and class backup, invalidating the previous archive so only one remains active.

sections.title: Levels 4, 8, 12, 16 and 19 — Ability improvement
sections.text: Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1, to a maximum of 20, or choose one eligible feat from the Feats.

sections.title: Levels 11, 13, 15 and 17 — Reserved Operations
sections.text:
At level 11, select one eligible tier-6 Contractor program. Execute that specific program once per Long Rest without an Execution Slot. At levels 13, 15 and 17, select an additional tier-7, tier-8 and tier-9 operation respectively.

Each has its **own** once-per-long-rest use. These do not count against known tier-1–5 programs. They are not interchangeable high-tier slots, cannot upcast lower-tier programs and do not return on a Short Rest. Their actions, concentration, modules and consumables still apply. The base class does not grant routine replacement of these selections.

sections.title: Level 20 — Emergency Reboot
sections.text: Spend one minute recalibrating to recover all expended Contractor Execution Slots. Once used, it recharges on a Long Rest. It does not restore Reserved Operations, firmware daily uses, artifact charges or supplies.

It produces two packets at total character level 5, three at 11 and four at 17. Roll each packet separately and choose its target separately. It is a direct quickhack requiring compatible live cyberware/electronics; its physical and software modes follow Execution. No projectile is produced. See Execution for its complete access rules.

architectureIntro: Choose an architecture at level 1. Expanded lists add learning options at program tiers 1–5; they do not give free known programs. The provider can be a corporation, stolen library or construct. Architecture describes the technology, not the provider's personality or the operator's allegiance.

architectures.title: Combat Architecture — Fiend
architectures.text:
**1 — Kill Confirmation:** reducing a genuine hostile creature to 0 HP grants temporary HP=max(1,class level+Cool modifier). No farming helpless manufactured targets.

**6 — Contingency Model [Dark One’s Own Luck]:** when making an ability check or Saving Throw, add 1d10 after seeing your roll but before its effects occur. No action required. **Uses: one; regain the use when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest.**

**10 — Adaptive Protection:** choose one bodily damage resistance from the ten types in Execution when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest; it lasts until you choose another with this feature. Calibrated weapon attacks bypass it; silver has no special property. The rig provides the relevant protection; resistances never multiply.

**14 — Feedback Cascade (D):** **Uses: one; regain the use when you finish a Long Rest.** No additional action; on an attack hit against an accessible compatible neural target or ICE, inflict 10d10 neural damage to a living target, or 10d10 Data damage to ICE integrity in its software mode; declare the mode before resolution. Uses ordinary wireless targeting; no preliminary breach check. Target remains physically present. 

Expanded pairs: Flame Jet [Burning Hands]/Priority Command [Command]; Sensory Cutoff [Blindness/Deafness]/Thermal Salvo [Scorching Ray]; Incendiary Burst [Fireball]/Nauseant Cloud [Stinking Cloud]; Thermal Feedback Daemon [Fire Shield]/Thermal Wall [Wall of Fire]; Vertical Burn [Flame Strike]/Secure Network Enclave [Hallow].

architectures.title: Deception Architecture — Archfey
architectures.text:
**1 — Presence Spoof (D):** Action; **Uses: one; regain the use when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest.** Targets in a 10-foot cube from you save Cool or become charmed/frightened, your choice, through your next turn's end. Requires compatible neural Cyberware within the area; ordinary wireless targeting.

**6 — Ghost Exit:** Reaction immediately after taking damage. **Uses: one; regain the use when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest.** Become Invisible until your next turn starts or you attack/execute a program; reposition harness moves you up to 60 feet on a visible traversable route, no opportunity attacks or ordinary movement cost. Cannot cross walls or escape restraints without a physical route.

**10 — Reflect Intrusion:** immune to program-induced charm. Reaction when a reachable source tries to charm you: source saves Cool against your Program Save DC or is Charmed by you for one minute, ending early if it takes any damage. Each triggering attempt permits this Reaction; no rest-based use limit.

**14 — Closed Simulation (D):** Action; choose one visible compatible neural target within 60 feet. **Uses: one; regain the use when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest, whether the target succeeds or fails.** On a failed Cool save against your Program Save DC, the target perceives only you, itself and your fabricated scene and is Charmed or Frightened by you (your choice). Concentration, up to one minute; ends early if the target takes damage. Body remains exposed.

Expanded: Target Paint [Faerie Fire]/Sedative Sweep [Sleep]; Stress Regulation [Calm Emotions]/False Sensory Feed [Phantasmal Force]; Evasive Cycle [Blink]/Crop Enrichment [Plant Growth]; Animal Interface Override [Dominate Beast]/Combat Cloak [Greater Invisibility]; Motor Override [Dominate Person]/Group Identity Mask [Seeming].

architectures.title: Intrusion Architecture — Great Old One
architectures.text:
**1 — Semantic Link (D):** At Will, no Execution Slot or rest-based use limit; one-way translated messages to visible compatible endpoints within 30 feet; no shared language needed if recipient understands a language. This is communication, not commands or thought reading.

**6 — Predictive Evasion [Entropic Ward]:** when a creature makes an attack roll against you, use your Reaction before that roll to impose disadvantage on it. If that attack misses, you gain advantage on your next attack roll against that creature, provided you make it before the end of your next turn. **Uses: one; regain the use when you finish a Short Rest or Long Rest.** The use is spent when you impose disadvantage, whether the attack hits or misses. Physical feint/defence telemetry works against offline attackers too.

**10 — Cognitive Firewall:** Passive, no action or limited-use pool; neural telemetry cannot read your thoughts without permission; neural resistance. A reachable neural attacker dealing neural damage takes the same damage you actually took through reflected feedback. No remote reflection through an absent connection.

**14 — Persistent Backdoor (D):** Action, At Will, one active subject at a time; touch an incapacitated implanted human; one subject remains charmed until clinical firmware clearance, charm removal or replacement by another subject. Commands are not compulsory: charm retains its normal limited meaning. Secure communication requires a real route. No saving throw or concentration; physical contact grants access for installation, not lifelong untraceable connectivity.

Expanded: Panic Signal [Dissonant Whispers]/Neural Seizure [Hideous Laughter]; Neural Tap [Detect Thoughts]/False Sensory Feed [Phantasmal Force]; Sensor Tap [Clairvoyance]/Priority Channel [Sending]; Animal Interface Override [Dominate Beast]/Motor Seizure Field [Black Tentacles]; Motor Override [Dominate Person]/Manipulator Swarm [Telekinesis].

programs.title: Actuator Command [Mage Hand]
programs.requirements: A reachable powered manipulator, door motor, dispenser or comparable actuator within range.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 30 feet; 1 minute. Choose one actuator. It makes an Intelligence security save if unwilling. On failure, or with permission, immediately perform one simple non-damaging manipulation within its actual reach: open an unlocked door, move an object, operate a lever or pour a container. Further commands use your Action. Maximum load 10 pounds. The routine cannot attack, activate a combat device, unlock security or exceed the actuator’s physical capability. Control ends beyond 30 feet, on route loss, or when you execute it again.

programs.title: Aversive Feedback [Vicious Mockery]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Enchantment utility Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Instantaneous Transmit an aversive auditory signal through the neural Cyberware of a creature you can see within range. If its auditory pathway can receive the signal (language comprehension is unnecessary), it must succeed on a Cool saving throw or take 1d4 neural damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. This program's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

programs.title: Caustic Burst [Acid Splash]
programs.requirements: An accessible powered dispenser containing enough corrosive chemical for the printed delivery; consume a dose per execution. Physical path and protection matter. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Conjuration utility Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Instantaneous A controlled dispenser launches a corrosive payload. Choose one creature you can see within range, or two creatures you can see within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a Reflexes saving throw or take 1d6 corrosive damage. This program's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

programs.title: Contact Short [Shocking Grasp]
programs.requirements: Reachable powered Cyberware or an electronic synthetic target. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack/save; current and heat originate in its own circuitry.
programs.text: Utility; Action; Touch; instantaneous. Melee Program attack against one compatible creature. Advantage if it is wearing conductive metal armour that provides contact access to its powered system. Hit: 1d8 Electrical damage and no Reactions until the start of its next turn. Damage becomes 2d8/3d8/4d8 at total levels 5/11/17.

programs.title: Contact Stabiliser [Spare the Dying]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable powered machinery matching the operation described below, its physical inputs, consumables and unobstructed delivery path. Learning supplies neither machine nor material. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Necromancy utility Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: Instantaneous You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This program has no effect on nonliving targets.

programs.title: Cryogenic Discharge [Ray of Frost]
programs.requirements: A reachable refrigeration/pressure controller and enough actual coolant/material for the printed volume; expend refrigerant. A tiny implant cooler cannot create a large storm. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Evocation utility Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Instantaneous A controlled emitter discharges refrigerant at a creature within range. Make a ranged program attack against the target. On a hit, it takes 1d8 cryogenic damage, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. The program's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

programs.title: Decoy Projection [Minor Illusion]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. Illusion utility Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: 1 minute You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or execute this program again. If you create a sound, its volume can range from a whisper to a scream. It can be your voice, someone else's voice, a lion's roar, a beating of drums, or any other sound you choose. The sound continues unabated throughout the duration, or you can make discrete sounds at different times before the program ends. If you create an image of an object—such as a chair, muddy footprints, or a small chest—it must be no larger than a 5-foot cube. The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. If a creature uses its action to examine the sound or image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your program save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

programs.title: Device Pulse
programs.requirements: One reachable noncombat electronic device within 60 feet.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 60 feet; instantaneous. The device makes an Intelligence security save. Failure permits one simple supported function: open or close an ordinary powered door, toggle a light, sound an alarm, eject media or start/stop a non-dangerous mechanism. The command cannot directly injure, operate a weapon, drive a vehicle, read protected files or defeat a dedicated security lock. Use Lock Override [Knock] for a locked door. A willing device needs no save, and its ordinary authorised use does not require this Utility. No scaling.

programs.title: Field Multitool [Druidcraft]
programs.requirements: A real reachable tool, manipulator, dispenser, printer or shelter system with sufficient raw material and physical capacity. No material, device or tool appears solely because a program is known. A manipulator needs an actual path and cannot exceed its printed load. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Utility; action; 30 feet; instantaneous; the weather display lasts one round. Through a reachable appropriate tool/controller, choose one: display a weather estimate from actual sensor data for the next 24 hours; open a mechanically supported seed/plant enclosure; create harmless light/sound/odour in a 5-foot cube from actual emitters/material; or light/snuff a small existing flame through a suitable ignition/suppression mechanism. No instant biological growth, certain weather prophecy or material creation.

programs.title: Firing Solution [True Strike]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Analysis [Divination] Utility Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 round Your actual targeting sensor analyses a visible target in range. On your next turn, you gain advantage on your first attack roll against the target, provided that this program hasn't ended.

programs.title: Heat Probe [Produce Flame]
programs.requirements: Reachable powered targets through direct wireless access or an established relay. Each damaged target must have compatible electronics or Cyberware.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 30 feet; instantaneous. Overheat a powered target’s internal components. Make a ranged Program attack; on a hit deal 1d8 Thermal damage. Damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at 11 and 4d8 at 17. This does not produce a physical flame or illuminate an area.

programs.title: Impact Buffer [Blade Ward]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Utility; Action; Self; until the end of your next turn. Defensive motor timing and pain-control feedback grant Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing and Slashing damage from weapon attacks.

programs.title: Impact Calibration [Shillelagh]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface. A club or quarterstaff held by the recipient executing the Program.
programs.text: Utility; Bonus Action; Touch; 1 minute. Calibrate your motor execution for one held club or quarterstaff. Use your execution ability instead of Body for its melee attack and damage rolls; its damage die is d8 and it counts as calibrated. Ends if you let go of it or execute this Program again.

programs.title: Light Command [Light]
programs.requirements: One reachable lamp, display or lighting controller at Touch range.
programs.text: Utility; Action; Touch; 1 hour. Override one light to produce steady bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20, limited by its actual output, in a colour it supports. You may extinguish it instead. An unwilling device makes an Intelligence security save to resist; a willing device needs none. Local ordinary controls cannot change your setting for the duration, but disconnecting its power stops output. You may end the Program with an Action; executing it again ends the previous instance.

programs.title: Lighting Spoof [Dancing Lights]
programs.requirements: Up to four reachable lights, signs or display controllers within range.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 120 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Each unwilling device makes an Intelligence security save. Control brightness, colour and simple light patterns on failed or willing devices; a Bonus Action changes their patterns. Keep each controlled device within 20 feet of another. Each lights at most a 10-foot radius, limited by its rated output. Local controls are overridden until the effect ends; removing power still works.

programs.title: Microrepair [Mending]
programs.requirements: A real reachable tool, manipulator, dispenser, printer or shelter system with sufficient raw material and physical capacity. No material, device or tool appears solely because a program is known. A manipulator needs an actual path and cannot exceed its printed load. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Utility; one minute; touch; instantaneous. A connected precision maintenance tool repairs a single break/tear no larger than one foot in an existing object if material and tool capacity suffice. No replacement of missing bulk, restored software/charges, biological healing, immediate disabled-chassis rebuild or bypass of armour repair/convalescence times. Normal equipment repair procedures control those specialised repairs.

programs.title: Motor Recall [Thorn Whip]
programs.requirements: A reachable integrated neural interface or motor controller capable of influencing the target’s movement. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack or save.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 30 feet; instantaneous. Make a melee Program attack against one visible compatible creature. On a hit, deal 1d6 Electrical damage; if it is Large or smaller, you may force it up to 10 feet towards you using its own locomotion. Stop at an obstacle or the end of a traversable route. This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Damage becomes 2d6 at total character level 5, 3d6 at 11 and 4d6 at 17.

programs.title: Neural Spike
programs.requirements: Compatible electronic or neural target as specified; wireless upload within range.
programs.text: Cantrip, evocation. Lists: Netrunner, Neural Adept, Contractor. One action; 60 feet; instantaneous; one living target with an integrated neural interface or one ICE. INT save against power DC; on failure 1d6 neural damage to the living target or Data damage to ICE integrity in the explicitly chosen software mode, none on success. Damage becomes 2d6 at total level 5, 3d6 at 11, 4d6 at 17. Does not harm a non-neural motor or inert terminal.

programs.title: Persuasion Coaching [Friends]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and live audiovisual or neural coaching interface.
programs.text: Tier 0; enchantment; lists: Rocker, Neural Adept, Contractor, Netrunner. Action, self, concentration 1 minute. Advantage on Cool social checks directed at one nonhostile person. Afterward target recognises the artificial manipulation and becomes hostile in attitude; response follows its actual motives. No mind control, attack advantage or compulsory agreement. Requires audiovisual coaching output.

programs.title: Presence Amplifier [Thaumaturgy]
programs.requirements: A real reachable tool, manipulator, dispenser, printer or shelter system with sufficient raw material and physical capacity. No material, device or tool appears solely because a program is known. A manipulator needs an actual path and cannot exceed its printed load. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Utility; action; 30 feet; up to one minute. Through real reachable audio/lighting/actuator equipment choose: amplify your transmitted voice threefold; flicker/change colour/dim a controlled light; generate harmless vibration; play a short sound; open/close an unlocked motorised door/window; or alter appearance of a connected cosmetic optic. The short sound and opening/closing are instantaneous; other effects last one minute. At most three one-minute effects coexist; an Action dismisses one. No direct change to an unaugmented body or control of a mechanical lock without an actuator.

programs.title: Reflex Prompt [Resistance]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Abjuration utility Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You touch one willing creature. Once before the program ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one saving throw of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the saving throw. The program then ends.

programs.title: Short Circuit [Eldritch Blast]
programs.requirements: Physical mode: reachable compatible powered cyberware/electronic actor or object whose circuitry can deliver destructive current. Software mode: reachable ICE/software instance. Each packet uses its declared mode and target; one hit affects one resource. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Utility; action; 120 feet; instantaneous. One separate ranged program attack against ordinary AC per packet; a physical hit deals 1d10 electrical damage; its explicit software mode below deals 1d10 Data. One packet, increasing to two/three/four at total character levels 5/11/17. Each may address the same or another legal target. Targets must be visible compatible powered cyberware, an embodied electronic actor, electronic object or ICE with a live route. Object AC/HP or ICE virtual AC/integrity applies. Ordinary attack-roll criticals, close-range disadvantage and cover remain. Overload occurs inside target circuitry; no projectile. Output Amplifier adds COOL to each hit. This does not remotely destroy every installed implant or harm an unaugmented person. Software mode: target a reachable ICE/software instance, using the same action, range, dice, scaling and attack/save procedure against its virtual defence. This mode deals Data to integrity, not physical or neural HP damage. Applicable control/repair-block riders affect only that instance. Choose mode per target before resolution; never damage its server or operator as well.

programs.title: Synaptic Lesion [Chill Touch]
programs.requirements: A compatible reachable powered/neural target whose exposed hardware can cause the specified feedback; bare organic flesh is invalid. A physical object uses object AC/HP when allowed. Software is eligible only through an explicitly printed software mode. No spectral limb, life theft or disintegration from an ordinary data packet. To block recovery, the addressed implant must control life-support/treatment signalling, or the synthetic endpoint must control repair. A cosmetic sensor alone cannot block healing. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Utility; action; 120 feet; instantaneous with rider until your next turn starts. Ranged program attack against one reachable compatible neural/synthetic target: 1d8 electrical on hit and cannot regain HP until your next turn starts. Against a nonliving autonomous synthetic, also disadvantage on attacks against you until your next turn ends. Damage 2d8/3d8/4d8 at total levels 5/11/17. The no-healing rider disrupts active life-support signalling, not a spectral hand; no direct effect on unaugmented flesh. Software mode: target a reachable ICE/software instance, using the same action, range, dice, scaling and attack/save procedure against its virtual defence. This mode deals Data to integrity, not physical or neural HP damage. Applicable control/repair-block riders affect only that instance. Choose mode per target before resolution; never damage its server or operator as well.

programs.title: Task Assist [Guidance]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Analysis [Divination] Utility Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You touch one willing creature. Once before the program ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The program then ends.

programs.title: Thermal Flash [Sacred Flame]
programs.requirements: A reachable powered electronic target or a living target with integrated powered Cyberware. The target’s own circuitry supplies damaging heat/current; wireless upload is part of execution.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 60 feet; instantaneous. One visible compatible creature makes a Reflexes save; failure deals 1d8 Thermal damage. Cover grants no bonus to this save, but total cover still prevents targeting without a valid relay. Damage becomes 2d8/3d8/4d8 at total levels 5/11/17.

programs.title: Thermal Spike [Fire Bolt]
programs.requirements: A reachable powered electronic target or a living target with integrated powered Cyberware. The target’s own circuitry supplies damaging heat/current; wireless upload is part of execution.
programs.text: Utility; Action; 120 feet; instantaneous. Ranged Program attack against one visible compatible creature or electronic object; on hit deal 1d10 Thermal damage from overheating its circuitry. Damage becomes 2d10/3d10/4d10 at total levels 5/11/17. Exposed flammable material in contact with the hot device can ignite if not worn or carried.

programs.title: Toxic Spray [Poison Spray]
programs.requirements: An accessible loaded chemical/pathogen dispenser with a physical route to recipients; expend an appropriate dose. A sealed functioning respirator blocks inhaled delivery. No invented poison or infection. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Conjuration utility Execution: 1 action Range: 10 feet Duration: Instantaneous A loaded dispenser directs a noxious spray at a creature you can see within range. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d12 toxic damage. This program's damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12), and 17th level (4d12).

programs.title: Utility Suite [Prestidigitation]
programs.requirements: A real reachable tool, manipulator, dispenser, printer or shelter system with sufficient raw material and physical capacity. No material, device or tool appears solely because a program is known. A manipulator needs an actual path and cannot exceed its printed load. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Utility; action; 10 feet; instantaneous or up to one hour. Use actual reachable equipment for one harmless effect: light/sound/odour/air puff; ignite or extinguish a small existing flame; clean or soil up to 1 cubic foot using reachable materials; warm/chill/flavour that much nonliving material for one hour; apply a temporary colour/mark for one hour; print a palm-sized disposable prop from reachable feedstock or project a palm-sized image until your next turn ends. Up to three noninstantaneous effects coexist; action dismisses one. No harmful temperature, electronics generation, valuable materials or large fire from nothing.

programs.title: Whisper Channel [Message]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Utility; action; 120 feet; one round. Send a quiet message to one known reachable compatible receiver; it can reply privately. Need a real signal route; acoustic silence does not block data, but actual shielding/air gaps do. It does not whisper directly into an unaugmented brain. No slot needed; ordinary open-channel speech remains ordinary communication.

programs.title: Adrenal Reserve [False Life]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: 1st-level necromancy Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: 1 hour Bolstering yourself with your neural biofeedback routine, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 2nd level or higher, you gain 5 additional temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

programs.title: Animal Behaviour Decoder [Speak with Animals]
programs.requirements: An actual compatible animal collar/interface or reachable sensor/training apparatus. Direct sensory/motor control requires a neural implant; an ordinary unimplanted animal cannot be quickhacked. Observational analysis can interpret behaviour but cannot invent fluent speech or consent. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 1st-level divination (ritual) Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: 10 minutes You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration. The knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, but at minimum, beasts can give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day. You might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favor for you, at the GM's discretion.

programs.title: Biohazard Scan [Detect Poison and Disease]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: 1st-level divination (ritual) Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case. The program can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

programs.title: Camera Loop
programs.requirements: One reachable camera or microphone within 60 feet.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; 60 feet; Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Intelligence security save; failure replaces its outgoing recording/feed with up to one minute of footage from that device, repeated seamlessly, while you can watch/listen to its real live feed. The initial minute can come from its accessible buffer; a device without a buffer uses a frozen frame until you have captured new footage. A watcher actively checking the discrepancy may use an Action for Intelligence (Investigation) against your Program Save DC to recognise the loop, not automatically end it. Local disconnection, a successful counter-Program or an Action and successful administrator Intelligence (Technology) check against your DC ends it. Each slot tier above 1 adds one device within 30 feet of the first; one Concentration covers all.

programs.title: Cargo Follow Daemon [Floating Disk]
programs.requirements: A real reachable tool, manipulator, dispenser, printer or shelter system with sufficient raw material and physical capacity. No material, device or tool appears solely because a program is known. A manipulator needs an actual path and cannot exceed its printed load. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier 1; action; 30 feet; one hour; ritual. Operate an actual cargo platform 3 feet across, supported 3 feet above ground, capacity 500 lb. It follows within 20 feet as you move. Cannot climb changes in elevation of 10 feet or more or cross a gap lacking physical propulsion/support; if separated beyond 100 feet the operation ends. It remains stationary within 20 feet unless moved by normal controls. Overloading ends powered lift safely if possible. Cargo falls only if its actual support fails. No generated disc of force.

programs.title: Combat Interference [Bane]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 1st-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Cool saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the program ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

programs.title: Emergency Brake
programs.requirements: One reachable powered vehicle with electronic throttle/braking control within 60 feet.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; 60 feet; until the end of your next turn. Intelligence security save; on failure apply maximum safe braking and prevent powered acceleration for the duration. A stopped vehicle has speed 0. A fast-moving vehicle decelerates according to its actual handling; the Program does not stop momentum instantly or shut down flight lift. An onboard operator may spend an Action and succeed on Intelligence (Technology) against your Program Save DC to clear it early. Each slot tier above 1 adds one vehicle within 30 feet of the first.

programs.title: Emission Scan [Detect Magic]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: 1st-level divination (ritual) Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes For the duration, you sense the presence of active program signatures within 30 feet of you. If you sense active program signatures in this way, you can use your action to see a diagnostic overlay around any visible creature or object in the area that bears active program signatures, and you learn its discipline, if any. The program can penetrate most barriers, but it is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

programs.title: Evasion Daemon [Mage Armor]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; Touch; 8 hours. One willing unarmoured recipient gains base AC 13 + Reflexes modifier through continuously predicted evasive movements. Choose this or another base AC calculation. Ends if the recipient dons armour or you dismiss it with an Action.

programs.title: Flame Jet [Burning Hands]
programs.requirements: A reachable ignition/heat controller and sufficient actual fuel or rated heating apparatus for the printed area and damage. Fuel is consumed; sustained effects need continuing fuel. A bare battery/spark is not a room-sized explosive source. Portable apparatus must actually be present and capable. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 1st-level evocation Execution: 1 action Range: Self (15-foot cone) Duration: Instantaneous Your fitted nozzle sprays and ignites its fuel in a cone originating at you. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a Reflexes saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 thermal damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites any flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

programs.title: Floor It
programs.requirements: One reachable powered ground vehicle with electronic drive control within 60 feet.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; 60 feet; until the end of the vehicle’s next turn. Intelligence security save; on failure, on its next normal turn the vehicle accelerates and moves up to its normal speed along its current heading or a route you specify when uploading. The driver can use its Action before that movement for a vehicle-control check against your Program Save DC to resist: Reflexes plus relevant vehicle proficiency; success clears the command. Use the normal collision rules and actual momentum. The Program grants no second movement or additional turn. An unattended vehicle acts immediately after you. Each slot tier above 1 adds one vehicle within 30 feet of the first.

programs.title: Food Decontamination [Purify Food and Drink]
programs.requirements: Actual food/water feedstock, reachable processing/purification machinery and sufficient supplies. Cannot create mass, nutrition or saleable products from software. Consume prepared food/medicine on use. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 1st-level transmutation (ritual) Execution: 1 action Range: 10 feet Duration: Instantaneous All reachable food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

programs.title: Hardware Analysis [Identify]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: 1st-level divination (ritual) Execution: 1 minute Range: Touch Duration: Instantaneous You choose one object that you must touch throughout the execution of the program. If it is an electronic item or other equipped controller, you learn its properties and how to use them, its documented integration requirements, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any programs are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a program, you learn which program created it. If you instead touch a creature throughout the execution, you learn what programs, if any, are currently affecting it.

programs.title: Identity Mask [Disguise Self]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 1st-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: 1 hour You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person— look different until the program ends or until you use your action to dismiss it. You can seem 1 foot shorter or taller and can appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change your body type, so you must adopt a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you. The changes wrought by this program fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this program to add a hat to your outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel your head and hair. If you use this program to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair. To discern that you are disguised, a creature can use its action to inspect your appearance and must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your program save DC.

programs.title: Jump Calibration [Jump]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; Touch; 1 minute. One willing recipient triples its jump distance through optimised motor recruitment and trajectory control. Jumping still spends movement and requires a physically valid launch and landing. This is a cinematic 5e movement enhancement, not flight.

programs.title: Language Parser [Comprehend Languages]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: 1st-level divination (ritual) Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: 1 hour For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear. You also understand any written language that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text. This program doesn't decode secret messages in a text or a glyph, such as an arcane sigil, that isn't part of a written language.

programs.title: Neural Seizure [Hideous Laughter]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 1st-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Upload involuntary motor disruption to one eligible creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Cool saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less isn't affected. At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another Cool saving throw. The target has advantage on the saving throw if it's triggered by damage. On a success, the program ends.

programs.title: Overheat
programs.requirements: Compatible electronic or neural target as specified; wireless upload within range.
programs.text: Tier 1, evocation. Lists: Netrunner, Neural Adept, Contractor. One action; 60 feet; concentration, up to one minute. One powered synthetic or a living target with substantial powered cyberware makes a CON save. On failure take 2d6 thermal damage and another 1d6 at the end of its next turn, then repeat the save to end the effect; subsequent failed saves continue the 1d6 at each turn end. Initial success negates the power. A target can use its action to shut down the addressed system and end the power, losing that system's benefit until it uses an action to restart it. Cannot address life support or fabricate fuel. Upcasting adds 1d6 to initial damage per tier above 1, not recurring damage.

programs.title: Panic Signal [Dissonant Whispers]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 1; enchantment; lists: Rocker. Action, 60 feet, instantaneous. Reachable neural target saves Cool; failure 3d6 neural and immediately uses available reaction to move as far as speed allows away from you, avoiding obvious hazards; success half/no movement. +1d6 per higher tier. Target unable to receive auditory neural input is unaffected. Forced reaction movement can provoke opportunity attacks.

programs.title: Perimeter Alert [Alarm]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable powered machinery matching the operation described below, its physical inputs, consumables and unobstructed delivery path. Learning supplies neither machine nor material. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 1st-level abjuration (ritual) Execution: 1 minute Range: 30 feet Duration: 8 hours You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the program ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you execute the program, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible. A mental alarm alerts you with a ping in your mind if you are within 1 mile of the warded area. This ping awakens you if you are sleeping. An audible alarm produces the sound of a hand bell for 10 seconds within 60 feet.

programs.title: Priority Command [Command]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 1st-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: 1 round You transmit a one-word instruction to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Cool saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The program fails if the compatible target cannot interpret your transmitted instruction or the command is directly harmful to it. Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the GM determines how the target behaves. If the target can't follow your command, the program ends. Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you. Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn. Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means. Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends its turn. Halt. The target doesn't move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

programs.title: Radial Motor Fault [Arms of Hadar]
programs.requirements: A reachable integrated neural interface or motor controller capable of influencing the target’s movement. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack or save.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; Self, 10-foot radius; instantaneous. Each compatible creature in the area makes a Body save. Failure: 2d6 Electrical damage and no Reactions until its next turn. Success: half damage and retains Reactions. Add 1d6 damage per slot tier above 1.

programs.title: Reader-Filtered Text [Illusory Script]
programs.requirements: A real compatible reachable electronic endpoint for the stated process; no direct action on unaugmented flesh or an air-gapped device. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 1st-level illusion (ritual) Execution: 1 minute Range: Touch Duration: 10 days Store a message on a supplied electronic display configured with authorised-reader filtering for the duration. To you and any creatures you designate when you execute the program, the writing appears normal, written in your hand, and conveys whatever meaning you intended when you wrote the text. To all others, the writing appears as if it were written in an unknown or encrypted script that is unintelligible. Alternatively, you can cause the writing to appear to be an entirely different message, written in a different hand and language, though the language must be one you know. Should the program be dispelled, the original script and the illusion both disappear. Full-Spectrum Diagnostics [True Seeing] can expose the hidden display layer through its actual diagnostic interface; ordinary sight cannot decrypt stored data.

programs.title: Retaliatory Overheat [Hellish Rebuke]
programs.requirements: Reachable powered Cyberware or an electronic synthetic target. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack/save; current and heat originate in its own circuitry.
programs.text: Tier 1; Reaction when a visible creature within 60 feet damages you; 60 feet; instantaneous. If it is a compatible powered target, it makes a Reflexes save for 2d10 Thermal damage, half on success. Each slot tier above 1 adds 1d10.

programs.title: Retribution Daemon [Armor of Agathys]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; Self; 1 hour. Gain 5 Temporary HP. While any of these Temporary HP remain immediately before a melee hit, the attacker takes 5 Electrical damage if its powered Cyberware or synthetic controller is reachable within 5 feet. This retaliation requires no Reaction or save. Each slot tier above 1 adds 5 Temporary HP and 5 retaliation damage. Temporary HP pools do not stack; replacing this pool ends its retaliation.

programs.title: Scout Drone Deployment [Find Familiar]
programs.requirements: One actual standard scout chassis, controller and payloads; Contractor Drone Link permits its additional specialist choices. Use chapter10 Scout Chassis and remaining specialist profiles. Locked/hostile equipment makes one Intelligence security save against Program Save DC during installation; unsecured/authorised equipment requires none. Operational electronics and actual access required; chapter02 applies.
programs.text: Tier1; one hour; range10 feet; persistent installed link; Slow Mode eligible. Fit/link one standard scout, Tiny except Small Submersible Manipulator; Drone Link may use its eligible specialist hulls, including the Small Sidewinder H4 Sensor Scout conversion. Extended installation uses Action and Concentration each turn until complete, but the resulting link needs no Concentration. Only one active scout link; replacing it ends the former special link without destroying that owned chassis. Scout has its own initiative, movement and actions; cannot attack unless a class feature permits. Routed commands cost no Action within100 feet. Action to use its senses until the start of your next turn, replacing your sight/hearing and gaining its applicable fitted special senses. Sensor Scout's ordinary live image feed remains free and does not require this takeover. Within100 feet a scout can deliver your Touch Program using its Reaction and your attack modifier, with actual delivery apparatus. At0 HP disable; repair/rebuild requires real parts and work, at least one hour for a rebuild. Action to physically stow a reachable scout or release its special link; Action to reactivate/deploy a stowed scout to reachable space within30 feet along its actual movement path. No teleportation, pocket storage or free replacement. Ordinary authorised recall uses its real receiver, navigation and travel time under chapter02, without another execution. The100-foot special sensory/relay limit remains unless a feature extends it. Persistent installation can be reset/counterhacked; acquiring a stolen unit does not erase provenance, tracking or remote administrator risks.

programs.title: Sedative Sweep [Sleep]
programs.requirements: A real loaded sedative dispenser able to reach breathing biology/skin within the printed area. This physical hazard can affect unaugmented targets, but requires a reachable machine and drug. Sealed protection blocks an inappropriate delivery route. No sleep through sound alone. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 1st-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 90 feet Duration: 1 minute A loaded dispenser delivers sedatives to eligible recipients in the area. Roll 5d8; the total is how many hit points of creatures this program can affect. Creatures within 20 feet of a point you choose within range are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious creatures). Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this program falls unconscious until the program ends, the sleeper takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the sleeper awake. Subtract each creature's hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature's hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected. Nonliving targets and creatures immune to the applicable sedative are unaffected; the charm-immunity exception is removed for this physical drug delivery. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 2nd level or higher, roll an additional 2d8 for each slot level above 1st.

programs.title: Service Daemon [Unseen Servant]
programs.requirements: One reachable service robot or manipulator within range with the physical tools for its assigned task.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; 60 feet; 1 hour; Slow Mode eligible. An unwilling device makes an Intelligence security save. Failure, or permission, installs a service routine. A Bonus Action assigns a simple noncombat task such as fetching, cleaning, packing or serving; it repeats the task without further actions until complete. Its movement is capped at 15 feet per round and carrying capacity at 30 pounds or its real rating, whichever is lower. It cannot attack, execute Programs or make skilled professional decisions. It stops if more than 60 feet away, the link fails, or it is destroyed. The physical unit keeps its actual AC and HP.

programs.title: Sprint Assist [Expeditious Retreat]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface; predictive motor guidance and biofeedback run through that interface.
programs.text: 1st-level transmutation Execution: 1 bonus action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes This program allows you to move at an incredible pace. When you execute this program, and then as a bonus action on each of your turns until the program ends, you can take the Dash action.

programs.title: Sustained Short [Witch Bolt]
programs.requirements: A reachable powered electronic target or a living target with integrated powered Cyberware. The target’s own circuitry supplies damaging heat/current; wireless upload is part of execution.
programs.text: Tier 1; Action; 30 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Ranged Program attack against one visible compatible creature: 1d12 Electrical damage on a hit. On subsequent turns, your Action automatically deals 1d12 Electrical damage to that target. Ends if you use your Action for anything else, the target leaves range, or total cover blocks the continuing route without a valid relay. Each slot tier above 1 adds 1d12 to initial damage only.

programs.title: Synthetic Countermeasures [Protection from Evil and Good]
programs.requirements: A willing recipient’s Cyberdeck or neural interface; reachable hostile synthetic controllers.
programs.text: Tier 1; action; touch; concentration up to ten minutes. A willing target’s Program-managed interface interferes with reachable autonomous hostile synthetics: their attacks against the target have disadvantage; they cannot impose charm, fear or control through that protected interface. Existing such effects allow advantage on any new save to end them. Not protection against ordinary people or offline weapon fire. No alignment detection.

programs.title: Target Paint [Faerie Fire]
programs.requirements: Reachable optical projector, display, lighting, camouflage system or compatible target sensory interface able to cover the printed space. Physical projections need line of sight and cannot become solid. A public camera is a sensor, not a holographic projector. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 1st-level evocation Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice). Any creature in the area when the program is executed is also outlined in light if it fails a Reflexes saving throw. For the duration, objects and affected creatures shed dim light in a 10-foot radius. Any attack roll against an affected creature or object has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature or object can't benefit from being invisible.

programs.title: Trust Exploit [Charm Person]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 1st-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: 1 hour You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Cool saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the program ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the program ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

programs.title: Visual Projection [Silent Image]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 1st-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual; it isn't accompanied by sound, smell, or other sensory effects. You can use your action to cause the image to move to any spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your program save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

programs.title: Vulnerability Tag [Hex]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Virtual marking requires a reachable software instance. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 1; enchantment; lists: Contractor. BA, 90 feet, concentration 1 hour. Visible reachable neural/robotic target; no initial save. Your attack hits add 1d6 damage of the triggering attack’s primary damage type. Choose one ability: its checks, NOT saves, have disadvantage. On target reaching 0 HP, transfer with BA on a subsequent turn to another legal target. Tier 3–4 duration 8 hours; 5+24 hours; tier 2 remains 1 hour. Firmware clearance can end it. Wireless targeting and monitoring follow chapter02. For a mixed-damage attack use its predeclared primary component. A software-target mode can mark reachable ICE; it affects its checks and adds Data to qualifying Data attacks. Marking software does not mark its server or operator.

programs.title: Acoustic Null [Silence]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable powered machinery matching the operation described below, its physical inputs, consumables and unobstructed delivery path. Learning supplies neither machine nor material. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; 120 feet; Concentration, up to 10 minutes; slow-mode eligible. Operate a reachable acoustic-cancellation and insulation system over a 20-foot-radius sphere centred on a point in range. Sound cannot be produced within or pass through its working field. Creatures wholly inside are Deafened. Creatures and objects wholly inside are immune to Concussive damage delivered by sound; pressure explosions remain physically destructive. Program execution continues through ordinary electronic control. The damping system must actually cover the area.

programs.title: Animal Sensor Relay [Beast Sense]
programs.requirements: An actual compatible animal collar/interface or reachable sensor/training apparatus. Direct sensory/motor control requires a neural implant; an ordinary unimplanted animal cannot be quickhacked. Observational analysis can interpret behaviour but cannot invent fluent speech or consent.
programs.text: Tier 2; divination; lists: Biosystems Operator, Nomad. Action, touch willing animal fitted with temporary sensor harness, concentration 1 hour, slow-mode eligible. Action to view/hear its feed; action to return to own senses. Your own sight/hearing unavailable while viewing. You benefit from special senses actually transmitted by the fitted sensor harness. Actual link required; no implantation or control of animal. Harness included in class module.

programs.title: Attention Capture [Enthrall]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable powered machinery matching the operation described below, its physical inputs, consumables and unobstructed delivery path. Learning supplies neither machine nor material. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 2nd-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: 1 minute You weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear you to make a Cool saving throw. Any creature that can't be charmed succeeds on this saving throw automatically, and if you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has advantage on the save. On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Intelligence (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the program ends or until the target can no longer hear you. The program ends if you are incapacitated or can no longer speak.

programs.title: Behaviour Injection [Suggestion]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 2nd-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 8 hours You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and influence through the compatible neural interface a creature you can see within range that can receive and interpret your transmitted instructions. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the program. The target must make a Cool saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability. The suggested course of action can continue for the entire duration. If the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the program ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do. You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might suggest that a knight give her warhorse to the first beggar she meets. If the condition isn't met before the program expires, the activity isn't performed. If you or any of your companions damage the target, the program ends.

programs.title: Biosignature Search [Locate Animals or Plants]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier2;action;self;instantaneous;ritual. Query accessible environmental sensors/records for the nearest identified animal or plant kind within5 miles. Return its direction and distance if evidence establishes them. An absent detection is not proof that none exist; plants do not speak and hidden organisms have no universal broadcast.

programs.title: Circuit Break
programs.requirements: Compatible electronic or neural target as specified; wireless upload within range.
programs.text: Tier 2, evocation. Lists: Netrunner, Neural Adept, Contractor, Medtech. One action; 60 feet; instantaneous. One addressed synthetic, electronic object or living cyberware user makes an INT save; inert objects use security grade modifier (consumer +0, commercial +1, secured +2, hardened +4, exceptional +6). On failure take 3d8 electrical damage, half on success. For a living target this is feedback to HP, not separately destroying every implant. Software mode targets reachable ICE with the same action, range, save, dice and scaling, dealing Data damage to integrity. Declare the mode before resolution; no simultaneous HP damage. Upcasting adds 1d8 per tier above 2. No automatic stun or device removal.

programs.title: Cold Preservation [Gentle Repose]
