programs.requirements: Actual reachable powered machinery matching the operation described below, its physical inputs, consumables and unobstructed delivery path. Learning supplies neither machine nor material. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier 2; action; touch; ten days; ritual. Operate reachable cold-storage equipment to preserve a body/remains against decay and contamination for the duration, consuming its normal power/coolant. Does not extend the one-minute resuscitation limit or enable a later resurrection.

programs.title: Courier Conditioning [Animal Messenger]
programs.requirements: An actual compatible animal collar/interface or reachable sensor/training apparatus. Direct sensory/motor control requires a neural implant; an ordinary unimplanted animal cannot be quickhacked. Observational analysis can interpret behaviour but cannot invent fluent speech or consent. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 2nd-level enchantment (ritual) Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: 24 hours By means of this program, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as a security officer wearing a specified uniform. You also speak a message of up to twenty-five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the program toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals. When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, through its fitted collar speaker, replicating your voice. The speaker plays only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn't reach its destination before the program ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you execute this program. At Higher Levels. If you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 3rd level or higher, the duration of the program increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2nd.

programs.title: Decoy Echoes [Mirror Image]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 2nd-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: 1 minute Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the program ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates. Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the program's duration, roll a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates. If you have three duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher to change the attack's target to a duplicate. With two duplicates, you must roll an 8 or higher. With one duplicate, you must roll an 11 or higher. A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Reflexes modifier. If an attack hits a duplicate, the duplicate is destroyed. A duplicate can be destroyed only by an attack that hits it. It ignores all other damage and effects. The program ends when all three duplicates are destroyed. A creature is unaffected by this program if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.

programs.title: False Sensory Feed [Phantasmal Force]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 2; illusion; lists: Rocker, Neural Adept, Netrunner. Action, 60 feet, concentration 1 minute. A visible living neural target saves Intelligence or perceives a fabricated phenomenon≤10-foot cube. The false feed includes sound, temperature and other sensations perceived only by that target. The target treats it as real and rationalises contradictory interactions while affected. An Action spent examining it permits an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Program save DC; success ends the effect. Once each round on your turn, a credible apparent creature or hazard can inflict 1d6 Neural damage if the target is inside or within 5 feet of the phenomenon. The target perceives the damage as appropriate to the false feed. No actual restraint, cover or created object. No autonomous-machine target. Player still chooses reactions to perceived events.

programs.title: Fault Loop [Cloud of Daggers]
programs.requirements: A reachable powered electronic target or a living target with integrated powered Cyberware. The target’s own circuitry supplies damaging heat/current; wireless upload is part of execution.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; 60 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Seed a 5-foot cube centred on a visible point. A compatible creature entering it for the first time in a turn or starting its turn there takes 4d4 Electrical damage. Add 2d4 per slot tier above 2. The cube is a software targeting zone, not a physical obstacle; each upload needs an unobstructed wireless targeting route from you or a valid relay.

programs.title: Hostile Motor Command [Crown of Madness]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 2; enchantment; lists: Rocker, Neural Adept, Contractor, Netrunner. Action, 120 feet, concentration 1 minute. A visible reachable human saves Cool or charmed. Before movement, target must use action for one melee attack against a creature you choose within reach, excluding itself. If none chosen/in reach it acts normally. On later turns you must spend action to sustain control. Target repeats save at each turn end. No control over dialogue; requires actual motor interface.

programs.title: Lift Rig [Levitate]
programs.requirements: Actual paired powered locomotion, tether, flotation or respiration apparatus suited to the printed movement/support. A traversable route, anchor and sufficient supply are necessary. No teleportation, flight, oxygen or mobility hardware from nothing. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier 2; action; 60 feet; concentration up to ten minutes. A real reachable lift/hoist/harness moves one visible creature or loose object weighing at most 500 lb vertically up to 20 feet. An unwilling target must already be physically attached and gets CON save to negate. Subsequent actions move it up/down 20 feet within range; if targeting yourself, use movement instead of an action. It moves horizontally only by pushing/pulling against reachable structures. On ending, hardware lowers it safely if functional; destroyed support can cause a fall. No telekinetic lift.

programs.title: Motor Lock [Hold Person]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 2nd-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Cool saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Cool saving throw. On a success, the program ends on the target. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

programs.title: Motor Profile [Alter Self]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; Self; Concentration, up to 1 hour. Select one neural motor profile: Aquatic gives a swimming speed equal to walking speed and advantage on Athletics checks to swim; Impersonation reproduces the voice and gait of a person you have observed for one minute and grants advantage on Deception checks to impersonate that person; Close Combat gives proficiency with unarmed strikes, a d6 Bludgeoning damage die, calibrated strikes, and +1 to their attack and damage rolls. An Action changes profile. Physical appearance, breathing supply and existing proficiencies remain unchanged.

programs.title: Neural Tap [Detect Thoughts]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 2nd-level divination Execution: 1 action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute For the duration, you can read the thoughts of certain creatures. When you execute the program and as your action on each turn until the program ends, you can focus your mind on any one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower or doesn't speak any language, the creature is unaffected. You initially learn the surface thoughts of the creature—what is most on its mind in that moment. As an action, you can either shift your attention to another creature's thoughts or attempt to probe deeper into the same creature's mind. If you probe deeper, the target must make a Cool saving throw. If it fails, you gain insight into its reasoning (if any), its emotional state, and something that looms large in its mind (such as something it worries over, loves, or hates). If it succeeds, the program ends. Either way, the target knows that you are probing into its mind, and unless you shift your attention to another creature's thoughts, the creature can use its action on its turn to make an Intelligence check contested by your Intelligence check; if it succeeds, the program ends. Questions verbally directed at the target creature naturally shape the course of its thoughts, so this program is particularly effective as part of an interrogation. You can also use this program to detect the presence of thinking creatures you can't see. When you execute the program or as your action during the duration, you can search for thoughts within 30 feet of you. The program can penetrate barriers, but 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead blocks you. You can't detect a creature with an Intelligence of 3 or lower or one that doesn't speak any language. Once you detect the presence of a creature in this way, you can read its thoughts for the rest of the duration as described above, even if you can't see it, but it must still be within range.

programs.title: Optical Blackout [Darkness]
programs.requirements: Reachable electronic optics, cameras, microphones or neural sensory interfaces for the senses affected. Feed manipulation affects those feeds; a physical projection additionally needs a real display, speaker or projector.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; 60 feet; Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Choose a visible point; for compatible electronic sight in a 15-foot-radius sphere around it, substitute a black feed. Affected observers are Blinded while inside. Affected cameras and optics cannot see out; unaffected observers outside can still see into the area. A valid relay can supply the targeting route. Multispectral Vision [Devil’s Sight] filters this Program. Physical light remains present.

programs.title: Optical Cloak [Invisibility]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 2nd-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour A creature you touch becomes invisible until the program ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The program ends for a target that attacks or casts a program. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

programs.title: Rapid Reposition [Misty Step]
programs.requirements: A willing integrated neural interface for motor assistance.
programs.text: Tier 2; Bonus Action; Self; instantaneous. A burst of motor guidance moves you up to 30 feet along a visible traversable route to an unoccupied space, without Opportunity Attacks or ordinary movement cost. Speed 0 and restraints prevent this movement. You cannot cross barriers or move where your body has no means of support. No upcasting.

programs.title: Risk Forecast [Augury]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 2; one minute; self; instantaneous; ritual. Analyse accessible information for a proposed action within thirty minutes. Report likely beneficial, harmful, mixed or indeterminate outcome, identifying uncertainty rather than guaranteed fate. Further uses before LR have cumulative 25% chance of an unreliable model. A model does not anticipate undiscovered intervening events.

programs.title: Sensory Cutoff [Blindness/Deafness]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 2nd-level necromancy Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: 1 minute You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the program ends. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

programs.title: Sonic Fracture [Shatter]
programs.requirements: Reachable industrial/portable machinery with the actual pressure, acoustic, pumping, excavation, cutting or panel-deployment capacity needed for this specific effect, plus materials. Cannot create force, move concrete with a speaker, or pass a solid wall without physically opening it. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 2nd-level evocation Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Instantaneous A sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, erupts from a point of your choice within range. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. A creature takes 3d8 concussive damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw. An uncalibrated object that isn't being worn or carried also takes the damage if it's in the program's area. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 2nd.

programs.title: Strength Inhibitor [Ray of Enfeeblement]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 2nd-level necromancy Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Upload output inhibition through a creature’s compatible motor interface within range. Make a ranged program attack against the target. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Body until the program ends. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the program. On a success, the program ends.

programs.title: Stress Regulation [Calm Emotions]
programs.requirements: A reachable integrated neural interface or motor controller capable of influencing the target’s movement. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack or save.
programs.text: 2nd-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a Cool saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects. You can suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this program ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime. Alternatively, you can make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a program or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the program ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the GM rules otherwise.

programs.title: Thermal Salvo [Scorching Ray]
programs.requirements: A reachable powered electronic target or a living target with integrated powered Cyberware. The target’s own circuitry supplies damaging heat/current; wireless upload is part of execution.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; 120 feet; instantaneous. Send three heat-fault packets at compatible visible creatures, dividing them as you choose. Make a separate ranged Program attack for each: 2d6 Thermal damage on a hit. Each slot tier above 2 adds one packet.

programs.title: Traversal Daemon [Spider Climb]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; Touch; Concentration, up to 1 hour. One willing recipient gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed and advantage on Athletics checks to climb. It uses ordinary handholds and footholds; difficult surfaces still require checks. If it already has powered adhesion, the daemon also permits hands-free vertical and ceiling movement using that adhesion. Normal climbing continues to require hands.

programs.title: Triggered Voice Message [Magic Mouth]
programs.requirements: A real compatible reachable electronic endpoint for the stated process; no direct action on unaugmented flesh or an air-gapped device. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier2;one minute;30 feet;until cleared;ritual. Configure an actual speaker/controller on an unattended object you can see. Record up to25 words delivered within ten minutes. Set a visual/audible trigger within30 feet of the controller, using only its actual sensors. On trigger play the message in the recorded voice/volume; choose one-time deactivation or repeat on later qualifying triggers. The device remains visible/physical and consumes ordinary power; no new mouth or sensor appears.

programs.title: Vehicle Override
programs.requirements: One reachable powered vehicle with electronic steering and propulsion within 60 feet; an AV must have a working flight controller.
programs.text: Tier 2; Action; 60 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Intelligence security save; on failure seize steering, throttle, brakes and ordinary doors. Immediately choose its next movement; on later turns use an Action to direct it, including a driving manoeuvre. It moves once per round on its normal turn, or immediately after yours if unattended, using its actual speed and handling. Remote driving checks use your Reflexes and relevant vehicle proficiency. You receive its available driving-camera/telemetry feed. An onboard operator can spend an Action on Intelligence (Technology) against your Program Save DC; success ends the takeover. You must maintain a live route within 120 feet of you or an authorised relay. On route loss, lack of a new command or expiry, onboard control returns; an unattended vehicle brakes or holds safe flight where possible. This does not operate weapons, create an autopilot, grant extra movement or guarantee collision damage. Each slot tier above 2 adds one vehicle; one Action can issue the same simple manoeuvre to all, but separate complex manoeuvres require separate Actions.

programs.title: Autopilot Daemon
programs.requirements: One reachable powered vehicle with electronic driving controls and sufficient real navigation sensors within 60 feet.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; 60 feet; Concentration, up to 1 hour. An unwilling vehicle makes an Intelligence security save. On failure, or with permission, install a temporary driving routine with a destination and route within one mile. It drives at normal speed and can collect or drop off passengers at specified stops. Its driving checks use your execution ability and PB if you are proficient with that vehicle type. A Bonus Action changes its instructions while within 120 feet or through a valid relay. It can continue the last safe route without continuous commands, but cannot deliberately ram, fire weapons or execute Programs. A local operator can clear it with an Action and successful Intelligence (Technology) against your Program Save DC. Each slot tier above 3 adds one vehicle; all share your Concentration.

programs.title: Crop Enrichment [Plant Growth]
programs.requirements: Accessible agricultural/environmental controllers and actual vegetation/material. No rapid biological growth beyond what existing engineered structures can deploy. Information comes from sensors; plants do not speak. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier 3; eight hours; 150 feet; Instantaneous treatment with a one-year agricultural result. Operate actual horticultural equipment to enrich existing plants within a half-mile radius centred on a point in range. Supply the required nutrients, water and treatment materials. Treated crops yield twice their normal food harvest over the following year. This Program has no instantaneous battlefield-growth mode.

programs.title: Device Detonation
programs.requirements: One reachable device within 60 feet with a real volatile battery, pressurised flammable supply or explosive payload capable of a 10-foot-radius blast.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; 60 feet; instantaneous. Defeat containment/interlocks and detonate the actual payload as part of this execution. Creatures within 10 feet make Reflexes saves: 6d6 Thermal damage, half on success. The payload is consumed and its host device disabled; survivors and passengers resolve damage normally. Each slot tier above 3 adds 1d6, only if sufficient explosive material exists. Confirm payload capacity before spending the slot. Do not add ordinary grenade/fuel damage again. Small Agents and bare cameras cannot supply this blast; use Circuit Break instead.

programs.title: Engram Playback [Speak with Dead]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 3; action; 10 feet; ten minutes. Access a supplied intact neural recording or stored engram and ask up to five questions. It answers only information recorded in its life, briefly and according to its dispositions; no obligation to tell the truth or explain unasked details. Cannot use this program on that same recording again for ten days. An ordinary corpse supplies no answers; does not create a person or resurrect one.

programs.title: Evasive Cycle [Blink]
programs.requirements: The willing recipient’s integrated neural interface. The software supplies predictive motor guidance and biofeedback through that interface.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; Self; 1 minute, no Concentration. At each turn end roll d20. On 11+, move up to 10 feet along a visible traversable route without Opportunity Attacks and gain +2 AC until your next turn starts through predictive evasion. Speed 0 or restraints prevent the movement. You may end the Program with an Action.

programs.title: Execution Interrupt [Counterspell]
programs.requirements: Accessible compatible controllers and a live route for the addressed security/defence process. Can manipulate ongoing network operations; cannot remove permanent hardware, undo finished injury or suppress independent mundane weapons. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 3; reaction when you perceive a program execution within 60 feet; instantaneous. Reach its emitting controller through a live route. Interrupt a program of tier no greater than your execution tier automatically; for a higher-tier program make an execution-ability check, DC 10 + its tier. Success prevents that execution; its spent action and slot remain spent. Utilities count as tier 0. Failure does not refund your slot. No prior session or additional breach check is required for this narrowly scoped defensive handshake, but an air gap or concealed unperceived activation prevents use. Cannot cancel mundane bullets, mechanical actions or an already exploded hazard.

programs.title: Feedback Siphon [Vampiric Touch]
programs.requirements: A reachable living neural target and your own neural interface; contact-range delivery.
programs.text: Tier 3; action; self; concentration up to one minute. Deliver a touch-range melee program attack through accessible neural hardware; hit deals 3d6 neural and triggers your own neural pain-control routine to recover HP equal to half damage actually dealt. On later turns use an action to repeat while duration remains. Each tier above 3 adds 1d6 per hit. This is feedback plus self-rally, not stolen blood/life or injury repair. Requires both systems; cannot farm damage against your own disposable devices for biological recovery.

programs.title: Firmware Clearance [Remove Curse]
programs.requirements: Accessible compatible controllers and a live route for the addressed security/defence process. Can manipulate ongoing network operations; cannot remove permanent hardware, undo finished injury or suppress independent mundane weapons.
programs.text: Tier3;action;touch;instantaneous. With physical access to an affected device/interface, clear all ongoing persistent-malware effects on one willing creature or one device, including Persistent Malware [Bestow Curse] and recoverable Memory Edit [Modify Memory]. Does not remove injuries, mundane restraints, class levels, factory ownership locks or all hostile programs indiscriminately. A malicious implanted item may be safely disconnected from its host, but its compromised firmware remains until separately repaired. This is malware clearance, not a supernatural curse or external-equipment attunement.

programs.title: Flight Governor [Fly]
programs.requirements: A willing recipient with powered flight, or a powered aircraft you are authorised to pilot. Touch its controller.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; Touch; Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Override conservative thrust and stability settings: increase the target’s flying speed by 30 feet, to a minimum of 60 feet. It has advantage on checks to manoeuvre through turbulence or confined flight paths. Each slot tier above 3 adds one willing compatible target. When the Program ends, ordinary flight remains at its normal performance. Maintain actual fuel, load and clearance limits.

programs.title: Incendiary Burst [Fireball]
programs.requirements: Sufficient existing flammable object, liquid or gas and reachable powered electronics able to ignite it. Wireless ignition, including an appropriate short circuit and any feasible controlled fuel release, is included in this Program’s action and slot. No separate ignition Program or dedicated ignition controller is required. Fuel is consumed. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier 3; action; 150 feet; instantaneous. At a visible point with sufficient combustible material and an electronic means of ignition, ignite a 20-foot-radius sphere. Each creature there makes Reflexes save: 8d6 thermal on failure, half on success. Fire spreads around corners in connected blast space and ignites unattended flammables. Each execution tier above 3 adds 1d6. Fuel is consumed; ignition hardware alone is insufficient. No extra engine-explosion damage roll for the same physical event. See Execution fuel sufficiency procedure.

programs.title: Latency Spike [Slow]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 3rd-level transmutation Execution: 1 action Range: 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Upload motor and processing interference to up to six eligible creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range. Each target must succeed on a Cool saving throw or be affected by this program for the duration. An affected target's speed is halved, it takes a −2 penalty to AC and Reflexes saving throws, and it can't use reactions. On its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, not both. Regardless of the creature's abilities or technological devices, it can't make more than one melee or ranged attack during each turn. If the creature attempts to execute a program with an execution time of 1 action, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the program doesn't take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the program. If it can't, the program is wasted. A creature affected by this program makes another Cool saving throw at the end of its turn. On a successful save, the effect ends for it.

programs.title: Life-Support Optimiser [Water Breathing]
programs.requirements: Up to ten willing recipients with accessible powered respirators, rebreathers or life-support systems within range.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; 30 feet; 24 hours; Slow Mode eligible. Adaptive gas management doubles the remaining operating time of each affected air or filtration supply while the Program runs and grants advantage on Constitution saves against environmental pressure and inhaled contaminants the equipment is rated to filter. Record the remaining supply on activation; refreshing the Program does not multiply it again. Recipients retain their equipment’s normal respiration modes when it ends.

programs.title: Live Translation [Tongues]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: 3rd-level divination Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: 1 hour This program grants the creature you touch the ability to understand any spoken language it hears. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says.

programs.title: Marine Autopilot [Water Walk]
programs.requirements: Reachable powered watercraft, amphibious vehicles or flotation rescue units, within range.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; 30 feet; Concentration, up to 1 hour; Slow Mode eligible. Address up to ten unarmed marine vehicles. Each unwilling controller makes an Intelligence security save. Failed or willing targets follow a shared safe route you specify within one mile of your position. A Bonus Action updates that route. They use normal speed, buoyancy and cargo capacity and can collect passengers at reachable stops. They cannot attack or deliberately ram. An occupied craft repeats its save at each turn end while its pilot spends an Action resisting; success frees that craft. Route loss stops it safely where possible.

programs.title: Medical Stasis [Feign Death]
programs.requirements: Reachable medical/life-support equipment and appropriate real medicine. Must physically reach the recipient or use its paired medical interface; no remote cure through a phone. Supplies consumed when administered; structural injuries persist.
programs.text: Tier 3; necromancy; lists: Rocker, Medtech, Biosystems Operator, Netrunner. Action, touch willing living target, 1 hour, no concentration, slow-mode eligible. Target appears dead, blinded/incapacitated/speed 0; resists damage except neural. Existing/new poison and disease effects suppressed, not cured. Action/touch ends early. Requires physical medical rig and one cartridge. Does not suspend resuscitation deadline after actual death.

programs.title: Mesmer Pattern [Hypnotic Pattern]
programs.requirements: Reachable optical projector, display, lighting, camouflage system or compatible target sensory interface able to cover the printed space. Physical projections need line of sight and cannot become solid. A public camera is a sensor, not a holographic projector. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 3rd-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Cool saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this program, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0. The program ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.

programs.title: Multisensory Projection [Major Image]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 3rd-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems completely real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. You can't create sufficient heat or cold to cause damage, a sound loud enough to deal concussive damage or deafen a creature, or a smell that might sicken a creature (like a troglodyte's stench). As long as you are within range of the illusion, you can use your action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation, for example. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your program save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 6th level or higher, the program lasts until dispelled, without requiring your concentration.

programs.title: Nauseant Cloud [Stinking Cloud]
programs.requirements: An accessible loaded chemical/pathogen dispenser with a physical route to recipients; expend an appropriate dose. A sealed functioning respirator blocks inhaled delivery. No invented poison or infection. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 3rd-level conjuration Execution: 1 action Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. The cloud lingers in the air for the duration. Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a Constitution saving throw against poison. On a failed save, the creature spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that don't need to breathe or are immune to the Poisoned condition automatically succeed on this saving throw. A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds. A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

programs.title: Panic Cascade [Fear]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 3rd-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: Self (30-foot cone) Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Cool saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration. While frightened by this program, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature can make a Cool saving throw. On a successful save, the program ends for that creature.

programs.title: Persistent Malware [Bestow Curse]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 3rd-level necromancy Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a Cool saving throw or become compromised for the duration of the program. When you execute this program, choose the nature of the malware from the following options: • Choose one ability score. While compromised, the target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability score. • While compromised, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. • While compromised, the target must make a Cool saving throw at the start of each of its turns. If it fails, it wastes its action that turn doing nothing. • While the target is compromised, your attacks and programs deal an extra 1d8 damage of that damaging effect’s predeclared primary type to the target. A Firmware Clearance [Remove Curse] program ends this effect. At the GM's option, you may choose an alternative malware effect, but it should be no more powerful than those described above. The GM has final say on such a malware effect’s limits. At Higher Levels. If you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. If you use an Execution Slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. If you use an Execution Slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. If you use a 9th level Execution Slot, the program lasts until it is dispelled. Using an Execution Slot of 5th level or higher grants a duration that doesn't require concentration. The damage rider amplifies the existing effect; it adds no damage to a nondamaging program. A software-target mode affects an explicitly reachable autonomous process; any damage rider on a Data attack is Data.

programs.title: Priority Channel [Sending]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 3; action; remote; one round. Through an existing actual communications route, send up to 25 words to a familiar authenticated recipient, who may immediately reply with 25 words. The program prioritises encrypted delivery through interference; it cannot reach an air gap, destroyed device or unknown address by naming a person. No interplanetary/infinite reach without infrastructure. Ordinary successful comms need no slot.

programs.title: Process Termination [Dispel Magic]
programs.requirements: Accessible compatible controllers and a live route for the addressed security/defence process. Can manipulate ongoing network operations; cannot remove permanent hardware, undo finished injury or suppress independent mundane weapons. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 3; action; 120 feet; instantaneous. Choose an accessible endpoint, object or ongoing program effect. End every eligible ongoing program on it at or below execution tier. For each higher-tier effect, separately roll execution ability against DC 10 + that effect tier; success ends it. Eligible effects are ongoing remotely addressable processes, not permanent hardware or instantaneous consequences. Ending a fire-control program cannot undo burns or extinguish a self-sustaining mundane fire without actual suppression equipment.

programs.title: Ride Overclock [Phantom Steed]
programs.requirements: Reachable compatible chassis/actuators, controllers, payloads and physical deployment space for every unit. Software does not summon, duplicate or create units. Use local profiles in chapter 09; no independent program execution unless explicitly recorded. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: Tier3;one minute;30 feet;one hour;ritual. Configure a reachable Large rideable robot with the Riding Horse profile in chapter09, except speed100 feet, travel10 miles/hour or13 at fast pace. Real saddle, control and propulsion required. One chosen rider operates it as a controlled mount. Damage, action dismissal or duration ends this high-speed mode; allow one minute to dismount before safe shutdown unless physical damage disables it sooner. No creature, vehicle or equipment is created or vanishes.

programs.title: Sensor Tap [Clairvoyance]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 3; ten minutes; one mile; concentration up to ten minutes. Access an existing reachable camera/microphone at a familiar or clearly identified location. Choose its visual or audio feed; action switches between them if both actually exist. The actual sensor remains physical, detectable and destructible, with its normal field of view. No sensor or route means no execution; familiarity cannot create hardware behind a wall.

programs.title: Sensory Killzone [Hunger of Hadar]
programs.requirements: A reachable integrated neural interface or motor controller capable of influencing the target’s movement. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack or save.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; 150 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Designate a visible 20-foot-radius sphere. Compatible creatures there are Blinded through sensory corruption and treat the area as Difficult Terrain through motor interference. Starting a turn there deals 2d6 Neural damage to a neural target, or Electrical damage to an uncrewed synthetic. Ending a turn there requires a Reflexes save; failure deals 2d6 Electrical damage. Valid uploads require access from you or an authorised relay. The zone does not physically obscure observers outside it or affect unaugmented creatures.

programs.title: Session Exclusion Ring [Magic Circle]
programs.requirements: Accessible compatible controllers and a live route for the addressed security/defence process. Can manipulate ongoing network operations; cannot remove permanent hardware, undo finished injury or suppress independent mundane weapons. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 3; one minute; 10 feet; one hour. Configure actual local boundary hardware covering a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder. Choose addressed autonomous synthetic categories. They cannot open hostile sessions across the boundary; their reachable attacks against protected recipients have disadvantage and cannot impose charm/fear/control through that boundary. Inverted configuration contains those categories’ sessions instead of excluding them. No impediment to a physical body walking through or to mundane gunfire lacking a compromised controller. Each execution tier above 3 adds one hour.

programs.title: Shelter Daemon [Tiny Hut]
programs.requirements: A reachable room or shelter with electronic locks, sensors and ventilation. Initial security save for an unwilling controller; no purchased special shelter module is required.
programs.text: Tier 3; 1 minute; self, 10-foot-radius area; 8 hours; Slow Mode eligible. Integrate the available locks, sensors and ventilation into an autonomous shelter routine. Choose up to nine other Medium-or-smaller occupants as authorised. Unauthorised electronic access attempts have disadvantage; any detected intrusion wakes resting occupants immediately. Occupants have advantage on Constitution saves against airborne environmental hazards that the actual filters can remove. The routine maintains safe settings and alerts you to power, air or structural failures within the installed sensors’ abilities. It persists if you leave. Physical doors, walls, filters and locks retain their actual ratings. A local administrator can clear the routine with an Action and Intelligence (Technology) check against your Program DC. No Concentration. No upcasting.

programs.title: Synapse Burn
programs.requirements: Compatible electronic or neural target as specified; wireless upload within range.
programs.text: Tier 3, evocation. Lists: Netrunner, Neural Adept, Contractor. One action; 60 feet; instantaneous. One living neurally connected target or ICE makes an INT save, taking 5d8 neural damage to the living target or Data damage to ICE integrity in the explicitly chosen software mode on failure or half on success. A failed target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn. Upcasting adds 1d8 per tier above 3. A non-neural robot is not eligible; use Circuit Break instead. No automatic kill below an arbitrary hidden threshold.

programs.title: Turret Override
programs.requirements: One reachable fixed turret or vehicle weapon controller within 60 feet, with real ammunition and a working mount.
programs.text: Tier 3; Action; 60 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Intelligence security save; on failure take firing and aiming control. The upload does not fire. On later turns your Action fires one attack using the mount’s printed attack bonus, range and damage, consuming its ammunition. It can also fire a supported burst using the armoury rules. No autonomous attacks, Multiattack or vehicle movement are granted. A local operator may use an Action and Intelligence (Technology) against your Program Save DC to end the override. A live route within 120 feet of you or an authorised relay is required; loss ends control. A controller cannot fire again through its ordinary owner on the same turn. No upcasting improvement.

programs.title: Adaptive Shell [Polymorph]
programs.requirements: A willing recipient’s neural interface and one reachable compatible robotic chassis within 5 feet.
programs.text: Tier 4; action; touch a willing conscious recipient; concentration up to one hour. Connect them to a reachable compatible robotic chassis within 5 feet using a studied local animal profile no higher in CR than their level/CR. Use chapter 03 Shell Link body vulnerability, shared actions, routes and ending rules. Retain recipient mental scores; no program execution through the shell. Shell HP is separate, no biological healing or overflow. Return as bonus action. No hostile transformation or generated chassis. Repair of a disabled chassis takes one hour/tools and another tier-4 execution; destroyed hardware needs replacement.

programs.title: Animal Interface Override [Dominate Beast]
programs.requirements: An actual compatible animal collar/interface or reachable sensor/training apparatus. Direct sensory/motor control requires a neural implant; an ordinary unimplanted animal cannot be quickhacked. Observational analysis can interpret behaviour but cannot invent fluent speech or consent. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 4th-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You attempt to beguile a beast that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Cool saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the beast is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it while a real routed connection remains available. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as “Attack that creature,” “Run over there,” or “Fetch that object.” If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability. You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time, you can also cause the creature to use a reaction, but this requires you to use your own reaction as well. Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Cool saving throw against the program. If the saving throw succeeds, the program ends. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program with a 5th-level Execution Slot, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. When you use a 6th-level Execution Slot, the duration is concentration, up to 1 hour. When you use an Execution Slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 8 hours.

programs.title: Combat Cloak [Greater Invisibility]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 4th-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: Touch Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the program ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

programs.title: Containment Lock [Banishment]
programs.requirements: A real compatible reachable electronic endpoint for the stated process; no direct action on unaugmented flesh or an air-gapped device. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 4; action; 60 feet; concentration up to one minute. One visible reachable compatible neural/synthetic target makes Cool save. Failure: incapacitated until program ends; remains physically present. Any damage ends its lock. Each execution tier above 4 adds one target with its own legal route/save. No other plane or permanent removal.

programs.title: Decision Scramble [Confusion]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 4th-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute This program assaults and twists creatures' minds, spawning delusions and provoking uncontrolled action. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must succeed on a Cool saving throw when you execute this program or be affected by it. An affected target can't take reactions and must roll a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior for that turn. d10 Behavior 1 The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction. To determine the direction, roll a d8 and assign a direction to each die face. The creature doesn't take an action this turn. 2–6 The creature doesn't move or take actions this turn. 7–8 The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn. 9–10 The creature can act and move normally. At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Cool saving throw. If it succeeds, this effect ends for that target. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 5th level or higher, the radius of the sphere increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

programs.title: Extraction Routine [Dimension Door]
programs.requirements: A willing integrated neural interface for motor assistance. One willing adjacent recipient also needs an interface.
programs.text: Tier 4; Action; 120 feet; instantaneous. Coordinate your movement and that of one willing adjacent creature of your size or smaller along a visible traversable route to visible unoccupied endpoints within range. Both travel together and provoke no Opportunity Attacks; the movement uses no ordinary movement allowance. Each must be able to move along that route; no passing walls, restraints, inaccessible gaps or occupied destinations. No upcasting.

programs.title: Metabolic Disruption [Blight]
programs.requirements: A live route into a living target’s powered physiological-control cyberware with actual destructive-current capacity; no software mode. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: Tier 4; action; 30 feet; instantaneous. Overload compatible exposed physiological-control cyberware in one living target you can see. CON save: 8d8 electrical on failure, half on success. Each tier above 4 adds 1d8. No effect on plants, corpses, unaugmented flesh or nonliving hardware; no plant-type vulnerability or automatic vegetation destruction.

programs.title: Motor Directive [Compulsion]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 4th-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Creatures of your choice that you can see within range and address through its neural interface must make a Cool saving throw. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can't be charmed. On a failed save, a target is affected by this program. Until the program ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a direction that is horizontal to you. Each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn. It can take its action before it moves. After moving in this way, it can make another Cool saving to try to end the effect. A target isn't compelled to move into an obviously deadly hazard, such as a fire or pit, but it will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction.

programs.title: Motor Seizure Field [Black Tentacles]
programs.requirements: A reachable integrated neural interface or motor controller capable of influencing the target’s movement. Wireless upload is included in the printed attack or save.
programs.text: Tier 4; Action; 90 feet; Concentration, up to 1 minute. Designate a visible 20-foot square. For compatible creatures it is Difficult Terrain. A compatible creature entering for the first time in a turn or starting its turn there makes a Reflexes save: on failure, 3d6 Electrical damage and Restrained until the Program ends or it escapes. A creature already Restrained by this Program instead takes 3d6 Electrical damage when starting its turn there. It may use an Action for a Body or Reflexes check against your Program Save DC, ending its restraint on success. Leaving the area ends its restraint. Uploads require a valid route; unsupported flesh is unaffected.

programs.title: Scenario Analysis [Divination]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 4; action; self; instantaneous; ritual. Query available evidence about a specific proposed goal/event/activity within seven days. Receive a concise evidence-based recommendation, with uncertainty; it may become wrong as circumstances change. Consumable analysis access/technical supplies required. After the first before LR, cumulative 25% chance of an inconclusive or misleading model, recorded privately. No foreknowledge of scripted outcomes.

programs.title: Sensor Crawl [Arcane Eye]
programs.requirements: One reachable camera or sensor network; each camera must physically exist and be connected within that network.
programs.text: Tier 4; Action; 30 feet to the initial endpoint; Concentration, up to 1 hour. An unwilling network makes one Intelligence security save. On failure, or with permission, obtain a live visual feed from its connected cameras. On activation and with each later Action, switch to another camera on that same network within one mile of the first. Receive its real visual capabilities while keeping your own senses. These feeds support ranged relaying under Execution, using your actions and Program ranges. Cameras remain vulnerable to destruction, isolation and return tracing. You gain no access to unrelated networks, files or control systems.

programs.title: Terrain Overlay [Hallucinatory Terrain]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 4th-level illusion Execution: 10 minutes Range: 300 feet Duration: 24 hours You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed in appearance. The tactile characteristics of the terrain are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to see through the illusion. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature carefully examining the illusion can attempt an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your program save DC to disbelieve it. A creature who discerns the illusion for what it is, sees it as a vague image superimposed on the terrain.

programs.title: Thermal Feedback Daemon [Fire Shield]
programs.requirements: A willing integrated neural interface for motor assistance.
programs.text: Tier 4; Action; Self; 10 minutes, no Concentration. Select Thermal or Cryogenic Resistance, supplied by defensive biofeedback. Whenever a reachable compatible powered creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2d8 Electrical damage from an automatic counter-intrusion. You may end the Program with an Action.

programs.title: Thermal Wall [Wall of Fire]
programs.requirements: A reachable ignition/heat controller and sufficient actual fuel or rated heating apparatus for the printed area and damage. Fuel is consumed; sustained effects need continuing fuel. A bare battery/spark is not a room-sized explosive source. Portable apparatus must actually be present and capable. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 4th-level evocation Execution: 1 action Range: 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration. When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Reflexes saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d8 thermal damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. One side of the wall, selected by you when you execute this program, deals 5d8 thermal damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

programs.title: Actuator Lock [Hold Monster]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. A motor effect requires motor access; mind/sensory manipulation requires a corresponding neural route. Ordinary unaugmented people cannot be affected directly. Hostile control does not dictate the protagonist’s opinions or voluntary dialogue. Wireless upload within printed range is part of execution; use only the printed attack/save, without a preliminary scan or breach check. A printed Touch range remains Touch.
programs.text: 5th-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Choose a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Cool saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. An autonomous synthetic with compatible motor control is eligible in this conversion. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Cool saving throw. On a success, the program ends on the target. At Higher Levels. When you execute this program using an Execution Slot of 6th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 5th. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

programs.title: Deep Query [Contact Other Plane]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 5; one minute; self; one minute; ritual. Contact a real reachable high-complexity archive or autonomous intelligence through your interface. INT save DC 15; on failure take 6d6 neural feedback and cannot execute programs until a Long Rest or treatment with Deep System Recovery [Greater Restoration], with disordered processing rather than invented external possession. On success ask five questions within one minute; answers reflect accessible knowledge, uncertainty and the source’s actual willingness, usually brief. No guaranteed truth, future knowledge or conjured contact.

programs.title: Environmental Survey [Commune with Nature]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 5; one minute; self; instantaneous; ritual. Analyse actual available environmental sensors/records within 3 miles outdoors or 300 feet in underground terrain; no result from inaccessible areas. Ask up to three categories: terrain/water; prevalent organisms/materials/population; major active synthetic signatures; infrastructure interference; or buildings. Answers are limited to evidence and may be incomplete. Does not detect planar influences, hidden identities or every person within range.

programs.title: Group Identity Mask [Seeming]
programs.requirements: Your Cyberdeck and reachable electronic sensory feeds. Alternatively, a real projector or speaker can reproduce the effect physically within its output limits.
programs.text: Feed mode affects compatible electronic observers within 60 feet of the subject/effect; ordinary eyes and offline sensors are unaffected. Physical-projector mode needs a real emitter. 5th-level illusion Execution: 1 action Range: 30 feet Duration: 8 hours This program allows you to change the appearance of any number of creatures that you can see within range. You give each target you choose a new, illusory appearance. An unwilling target can make a Cool saving throw, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this program. The program disguises physical appearance as well as clothing, armor, weapons, and equipment. You can make each creature seem 1 foot shorter or taller and appear thin, fat, or in between. You can't change a target's body type, so you must choose a form that has the same basic arrangement of limbs. Otherwise, the extent of the illusion is up to you. The program lasts for the duration, unless you use your action to dismiss it sooner. The changes wrought by this program fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this program to add a hat to a creature's outfit, objects pass through the hat, and anyone who touches it would feel nothing or would feel the creature's head and hair. If you use this program to appear thinner than you are, the hand of someone who reaches out to touch you would bump into you while it was seemingly still in midair. A creature can use its action to inspect a target and make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your program save DC. If it succeeds, it becomes aware that the target is disguised.

programs.title: Heavy Chassis Deployment [Conjure Elemental]
programs.requirements: One existing reachable specialist chassis with a compatible operational controller and its actual equipment. Standby needs live wake electronics; fully unpowered/isolated machines need power/access first. A locked or hostile controller makes one Intelligence security save against Program Save DC, using chapter02 grades if it has no relevant chassis save. No save for unsecured/authorised equipment.
programs.text: Tier5; Action; range90 feet; duration1 hour; no ongoing Concentration. Take control of one actual specialist chassis CR5 or lower using its established profile. Each execution tier above5 increases maximum CR by1. Allow the chassis's actual occupied space and route; it does not appear in a new10-foot square. Acts immediately after you; preserve an existing unit's old initiative until next round to prevent another turn. Routed commands cost no Action; queued achievable orders continue without a link. Without orders defend in place. No new hardware, fuel, ammunition, HP or autonomous Programs. At expiry owned machinery keeps normal authorised control; other units revert to their established controller/failsafe, or halt if none. No random hostility from taking damage or losing Concentration. Actual reset, power loss, successful counterhack or destruction can end the routine. Temporary control does not transfer permanent credentials or ownership.

programs.title: Inference Query [Commune]
programs.requirements: Actual reachable sensor, stored record or communications/analysis system appropriate to the query. Missing evidence gives an explicit gap; no omniscience.
programs.text: Tier 5; 1 minute; Self; 1 minute; Slow Mode eligible. Run an intensive inference daemon across accessible records about a declared subject. Ask three yes/no questions about facts those records support. The routine correlates hidden relationships and conflicting accounts rather than merely asking an expert; answer unknown where evidence is insufficient. You have advantage on your next Intelligence (Investigation) check applying its findings within 1 hour. Later executions before a Long Rest have a cumulative 25% chance of overfitting, producing no reliable new conclusions or advantage. No prediction of inaccessible facts or created credentials.

programs.title: Manipulator Swarm [Telekinesis]
programs.requirements: A real reachable tool, manipulator, dispenser, printer or shelter system with sufficient raw material and physical capacity. No material, device or tool appears solely because a program is known. A manipulator needs an actual path and cannot exceed its printed load. The device may belong to anyone. Execution includes overriding its controller; no ownership, pairing or preliminary breach is required. See chapter 02 for environmental control and occupied-device resistance.
programs.text: 5th-level transmutation Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Activate reachable powered manipulators that can physically reach the target. When you execute the program, and as your action each round for the duration, you can direct the manipulators against one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round, or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the program. Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. Make an ability check with your execution ability contested by the creature's Body check. If you win the contest, you move the creature up to 30 feet in any direction, including upward but not beyond the range of this program. Until the end of your next turn, the creature is restrained in your manipulator grip. A creature lifted upward is suspended in mid-air. On subsequent rounds, you can use your action to attempt to maintain your manipulator grip on the creature by repeating the contest. Object. You can try to move an object that weighs up to 1,000 pounds. If the object isn't being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction, but not beyond the range of this program. If the object is worn or carried by a creature, you must make an ability check with your execution ability contested by that creature's Body check. If you succeed, you pull the object away from that creature and can move it up to 30 feet in any direction but not beyond the range of this program. You can exert fine control on objects with your manipulator grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.

programs.title: Motor Override [Dominate Person]
programs.requirements: Compatible reachable neural, sensory or motor-control cyberware supporting the specific effect. programs.text: 5th-level enchantment Execution: 1 action Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a Cool saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw. While the target is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it while a real routed connection remains available. You can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey.
